title: Lentil Bolognese
description: A simple, saucy brown lentil Bolognese over whole wheat pasta — quicker than the walnut version.
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic, then add the lentils, tomatoes and enough water to cover.
Simmer 25 minutes until the lentils are tender and the sauce has thickened.
Serve over the cooked pasta with basil and parmesan.
notes: This is the faster, weeknight version — swap in the walnut Bolognese when you have more time.
